plan_metadata.name: Sample todo list sql Local Debug

steps.description: Click the "Search samples..." input field in the Samples tab of the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit extension within Visual Studio Code. This focuses the search bar, allowing the user to type and filter available sample agents.
Type text: 'todo list sql' into the search input field located in the "Samples" tab of the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit extension within Visual Studio Code.

Click the "Create" button next to the "Todo List with backend" sample in the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit "Samples" gallery within Visual Studio Code. And input ${{var:app_name:todo-list-with-Azure-backend}} into the run time variable.

parameters.sample:
=== Generated Script ===
Language: bash

```bash
env_file="/home/vscode/AgentsToolkitProjects/todo-list-with-Azure-backend/env/.env.local.user"

if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
    echo "Error: File $env_file does not exist."
    exit 1
fi

# Remove any existing lines for these keys
sed -i '/^SQL_USER_NAME=/d' "$env_file"
sed -i '/^SQL_PASSWORD=/d' "$env_file"
sed -i '/^SQL_ENDPOINT=/d' "$env_file"
sed -i '/^SQL_DATABASE_NAME=/d' "$env_file"

# Append the new values
{
    echo 'SQL_USER_NAME="vscuse-admin"'
    echo 'SQL_PASSWORD="${{secret:SECRET_SQL_PASSWORD:}}"'
    echo 'SQL_ENDPOINT="vscuse-testing.database.windows.net"'
    echo 'SQL_DATABASE_NAME="todo-list"'
} >> "$env_file"

echo "Variables written to $env_file:"
grep 'SQL_' "$env_file"
```
